Product Profile
Bina Dhan 11 is a high-yielding, early-maturing, semi-dwarf, medium-slender variety suitable for rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BINA in Bangladesh, it was later released in India in 2015 for planting in both wet and dry seasons. This variety exhibits tolerance to leaf blast and sheath blight, and can withstand submergence for up to two weeks, though it is susceptible to stagnant water conditions.

Key Strengths
- Good yield
- Early maturity
- Medium slender grain with high weight
- Semi-dwarf
- Submergence tolerant, suitable in both kharif and rabi season
